snippet.title: Where Winds Meet - Hidden Mountain - Official Announce Trailer | XBOX Games Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Where Winds Meet, the new Expansion "Hidden Mountain" is coming soon to XBOX. Explore a brand-new map and enjoy martial arts adventures with exciting new content.

Where Winds Meet is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC as an XBOX Play Anywhere title and with XBOX Game Pass.
